rules.rationale: These A13 patches form the final Linux 5.15 BlueStacks filesystem hook layer, process/proc presentation, emulator-string filtering, app UID policy, ptrace/kallsyms restrictions, SELinux audit filtering and application-specific compatibility fixes. Android 16 uses kernel-a16; every surviving changed line maps to the corresponding final target file, with only the later A13 revisions winning where several commits touch bst_hooks.c.
rules.necessity: Required for the established guest filesystem contract, host path translation, application compatibility and intended process/device presentation.
rules.performance: Adds UID and path checks to selected VFS/proc/stat operations. A13 includes caching/optimized UID classification; final regression must watch syscall-heavy workloads and boot time.
rules.security: High-risk kernel surface: intentionally filters proc/device information and adds privileged path hooks. Bounds, user-pointer handling, recursion avoidance and privilege gates must remain covered by kernel review and runtime tests.
validation_evidence: Commit-level audit reports complete final line evidence for all files except fs/bst_hooks.h in ec3320cd, where partial evidence is expected because later A13 patches revise the same helper. The final header and implementation are present in kernel-a16.
Android-16 root tracks kernel-a16 10d61b7393ec37012e27530bf344c559da766590 on aosp16-bst-merge; eee2a2da is its AOSP16/A13 semantic merge commit.

rules.rationale: This group preserves A13 boot-time input/cgroup tuning, AHCI fast paths, quiet boot, pcd/pcr memory controls, low-memory lmkd correction, CPU-idle policy and tty input compatibility. All surviving hunks are present in kernel-a16.
rules.necessity: Required for the validated BlueStacks boot/storage/input behavior and memory-mode compatibility.
rules.performance: Intentionally trades generic hardware delays and CPU idle power savings for lower virtual-disk/input latency. Memory controls can affect reclaim pressure; final regression needs boot-time, I/O latency and memory-pressure evidence.
rules.security: TTY permission bypass and custom memory sysctls require product/UID confinement. AHCI shortcuts are valid only for the known virtual controller contract.
validation_evidence: Every surviving A13 file in this group has complete line evidence in kernel-a16 at the audit head.

rules.rationale: These commits establish the A13 x86_64 defconfig, boot init/default header, Tiramisu identification, NLS, virtualization/media options, disabled unused DRM/USB options and removal of empty prebuilt gitlinks. Android 16 kernel-a16 preserves the final semantic state and additionally enables SquashFS for system.sfs.
rules.necessity: Required for the android_x86_64 Windows board, bootloader contract and packaged system filesystem.
rules.performance: Configuration removes unused drivers and enables required virtualization/filesystem features, reducing irrelevant initialization while adding only selected kernel code.
rules.security: Kernel config defines attack surface. Disabled unused drivers reduce exposure; enabled virtualization, NLS, videobuf and SquashFS options must stay limited to required product functionality.
validation_evidence: All final config/boot hunks map to kernel-a16; e8368878 partial defconfig evidence is explained by later A13 defconfig commits and the final target config is compared at head.

rules.rationale: A13 selects the user-specified UMH program through the product defconfig; kernel-a16 retains the final configuration.
rules.necessity: Required only for the established BlueStacks kernel helper contract.
rules.performance: No cost unless the kernel invokes the configured helper.
rules.security: Usermode helper execution is privileged and must use an immutable, trusted path with controlled arguments.
validation_evidence: The final defconfig line has complete evidence in kernel-a16.
